---
name: Copyright or takedown request
about: Report a SkillTube listing that you believe infringes your rights
title: "[Takedown] "
labels: legal
assignees: ""
---

Please include enough information for us to review the request:

1. Your name and contact details.
2. The work you own or represent and where it is published.
3. The SkillTube URL for the listing.
4. Why you believe the listing infringes your rights.
5. A statement that the information is accurate and that you are the owner or authorised to act for the owner.
6. Your signature (a typed name is fine).

Do not include sensitive personal information that is not needed to assess the request.
